A lists of spells available to be prepared by the Arcane Trickster subclass of Rogue.

Overview

The spell list is the same as the Wizard's, but with only non-cantrip spells from the schools of Enchantment or Illusion plus every wizard cantrip. However, Arcane Tricksters may learn a spell from the entire wizard spell list at levels 3 and 8. The Replacement Spell Feature also allows an Arcane Trickster to swap any known spell with any spell from the full wizard spell list, once per level starting at class level 4.

Arcane Trickster spells will use the caster's Intelligence modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

The following spell list is the limited version. For the full list of Wizard spells from every spell school, see the Wizard Spell List.
